policy: Primary measurement: abapiti lower --full with --overrides none (default), --assume-int=false and --scope tools/gogen. No pruning or failure traps. Supplemental spike driver: actual JS imports loaded; raw LowerWithOptions first, then independent TrapOnFailure run. No applied source overrides, integer assumptions, or handwritten declaration stubs. Recovered refusal counts are diagnostic records, not unique causes or successful executable bodies. Full raw panics invalidate raw counts; repair-note counts are lower-bound observations, with no claim of a complete raw inventory.
rootGrouping: Manual primary-cause attribution from source fields/signatures and messages; inferred, not a causal experiment. Compiler Cascade flags reported only on raw diagnostics. Source-independent tag narrowing and shared discriminants have zero direct pilot blockers; simple nonrecursive probes lower, while earlier failed signatures conceal real body uses. Untyped implementation refusals are untriaged, not assigned to union causes.
